name: Birdeye
oneLiner: Agentic marketing and reputation platform for multi-location brands, covering reviews, listings, messaging, social, surveys and AI search visibility, with AI agents and 'AI Coworkers' that carry out the work.
bestFor: Multi-location brands and franchise groups, including restaurant chains, that want reviews, listings, messaging and social in one platform with AI agents doing much of the execution.

updates.text: Launched a restaurant-specific AI marketing platform built on proprietary LLMs trained for the restaurant industry, including Yelp review monitoring through a Yelp partnership.
Announced an Uber Eats integration (June 27, 2025): menu and shop details sync from Uber Eats to the restaurant's business listings.
Unveiled its Agentic Marketing Platform at View 2025, with more than 10 AI agents automating work across reviews, listings, social media and surveys.

Launched AI Coworkers at View 2026 (September 9, 2026): Jay (marketing: AI visibility, search, listings, reviews, social), Myna (operations: appointment bookings, front-desk calls, reminders, waitlists, insurance verification) and Robin (customer experience: surveys, sentiment analysis, ticketing, insights), which together orchestrate 27 AI agents.
Announced a SkyTab POS integration (September 29, 2026) that syncs restaurant business and menu details from SkyTab to listings.

features: Review monitoring across Google, Yelp, Facebook and industry sites, with alerts and ticketing that routes negative reviews to the right location manager
Review requests by SMS and email to grow review volume
AI-drafted and agent-handled review responses in the brand's voice
Listings management that keeps business details and menus accurate across directories, including menu sync from SkyTab and Uber Eats for restaurants
Unified inbox for SMS, webchat, social messages and email
Surveys and Insights AI sentiment analysis with location, district and region reporting
Search AI for tracking and improving visibility in AI answer engines

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Birdeye does not publish prices. Its pricing page says you get 'one platform, one contract' and 'pay only for what you deploy at your locations', and asks for your number of locations to send a quote.

notes: birdeye.com/pricing and the AI Coworkers release were opened in November 2026; other details come from search snippets of birdeye.com press, case-study and update pages. G2 shows 4.7 out of 5 on every page seen, but the review count differs between snapshots (about 3,900 to 4,300), so no count is cited. Birdeye's AI Coworkers release also says its agents have responded to more than 12 million reviews and that it holds #1 positions in 30 G2 categories; vendor claims, not used. Dropped from the current review: '150,000 businesses', '150+ platforms', '50+ directories' and the ~$299/month Standard plan price (third-party estimate only; third parties list Starter $299, Growth $349, Dominate $449 per location, none published by Birdeye).
pros: One platform for reviews, listings, messaging, social, surveys and AI search visibility
AI agents and AI Coworkers carry out routine work such as review replies and listings updates
Restaurant-specific AI version (2025) with Yelp review monitoring through a Yelp partnership
Menu details sync to listings from SkyTab and Uber Eats
Location, district and region reporting for multi-location brands

cons.text: No published prices; you ask for a quote and give your number of locations
Priced by what you deploy at your locations, so the quote depends on how many locations and modules you take
Built for multi-location brands in many industries: part of the AI Coworkers' scope, such as Myna's appointment bookings and insurance verification, isn't relevant to restaurants
Built for multi-location brands and franchise groups, so a single restaurant may need far less than the full platform

plans.billing: custom quote based on locations and the products you deploy, under one contract
